title: Fleet Command: Unified scaling controls, throughput dashboard, and change ledger for Dedicated fleets
creator: Avery Kim
description: Goal: Deliver a single Fleet Command surface in Console that lets operators configure scaling controls, observe throughput guarantees, and inspect a tamper-evident change history for Dedicated fleets. Scope covers UI patterns, backend contract changes, role-gated actions, and a lightweight diffable ledger for all operator-driven edits. Success criteria: 1) Operators can set a committed throughput (tokens/sec or RPS equivalent) and a policy for autoscaling (target utilization, min/max nodes, cooldowns) in one flow; 2) Console shows per-fleet real-time and historical throughput charts with cost and latency overlays; 3) All changes are recorded with before/after diffs, author, timestamp, and optional operator note; 4) Ability to rollback the latest change by allowed roles; 5) Minimal runtime/serving changes and backward-compatible API for Dedicated control plane.
background: Customers on Dedicated want predictable throughput SLOs while still leveraging autoscaling to reduce cost. Current Console surfaces are scattered: scaling presets live in Capacity Hub, throughput charts in Fleet Telemetry, and change logs are split across audit-logs and infra events. This leads to operator friction during incidents and onboarding. This ticket consolidates the experience into a Fleet Command panel that ties configuration, observability, and provenance together.
decisions: Expose 'Committed Throughput' as a first-class numeric field (tokens/sec) rather than abstract 'units' to improve cross-team clarity
Autoscale policy model will be simplified to: target_utilization_pct, min_replicas, max_replicas, cooldown_seconds, burst_capacity (boolean + % headroom)
Change ledger will store semantic diffs (pre-change, post-change) and immutable entries linked to operator identity; ledger entries are readable from Console and available via API (read-only)
Rollback will be implemented as a new change entry that reapplies the previous config; rollback action requires 'fleet-admin' role per RBAC mapping
tradeoffs: We considered fully event-sourced config for fleets but chose a hybrid: canonical config per fleet + immutable ledger of diffs. This reduces runtime complexity and the number of read hops for the serving control plane at the expense of duplicating small amounts of metadata. We also limit historical chart retention to 90 days in Console by default to avoid storage bloat, with add-on retention available.
work_items: Design high-fidelity Fleet Command panel and compact timeline component (DES-413)
Backend API: add fleet config endpoints and ledger write API (ENG-2784)
Telemetry: surface throughput (tokens/sec), p95 latency, and cost-per-token in the same chart (ENG-2839)
RBAC: add 'fleet-admin' and 'fleet-operator' roles for change/rollback permissions (ENG-2890)
E2E tests: config round-trip, ledger immutability, rollback flow (ENG-2941)
Docs: Console guide, runbook, and release notes (DOCS-112)
Migration: reconcile existing scaling presets into new model (PM-904)
Canary: rollout to internal Dedicated tenants then opt-in customers
comments: [2025-02-18] Avery Kim: Kickoff - scoped consolidation of scaling UI, throughput charts, and change ledger. Assigned Diego for PM-ENG coordination. Asked Design to propose a compact timeline because operators want a single-pane view.

[2025-02-20] Diego Martinez: Design draft received (Figma link above). Two variants: detailed ledger-first vs controls-first. Preferring controls-first UI to reduce accidental drift during incidents. Asked Eng for API compatibility constraints.

[2025-02-22] Priya Shah (Engineering): Backend schema proposal posted. Adds 'committed_throughput' and 'autoscale_policy' to fleet config. Ledger entries are append-only with operator_id and optional note. Flagged potential database index hot-spot; proposed sharding by fleet_id.

[2025-02-24] Marco Liu (Design review): Usability test notes from 5 ops engineers: they expect rollback to be a reversible explicit action and want clear indicators when a change was applied vs when it's pending. Updated mocks to add 'pending' badge for rollout jobs.

[2025-02-26] Diego Martinez: Tradeoff decision - hybrid approach accepted (canonical config + ledger). Added a migration plan to import existing presets during weekend maintenance. Noted we will limit default chart retention to 90 days.

[2025-02-27] Security review (S. Patel): Confirmed no sensitive fields are written to ledger. Ensure operator notes are sanitized and KMS remains used for any secret references (note: no secrets allowed in fleet config).
[2025-02-28] Diego Martinez: Backend PR opened. ENG-2784 links to GH. QA to start smoke tests on staging fleet. Planning internal canary with two Dedicated customers next week.

[2025-03-01] Avery Kim: Added acceptance criteria and success metrics: reduce mean time-to-apply-scaling-change by 30% for ops, and surface throughput anomalies within 2 minutes on Console charts. Also added rollout gating criteria for GA.
